tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Free-text search across every Netbrain product and platform — names, descriptions, capabilities, technologies and tags. Use this to answer questions like "does Netbrain do static analysis for Kotlin", "what can they do for KYC compliance", or "do they have anything for African languages". Returns ma

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full detail for a single Netbrain product or platform, by slug. Use search_products first if you do not already know the slug.

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: Everything Netbrain builds, grouped by category, with the capabilities and technologies under each. Use this for open questions like "what does Netbrain do" or "can they help with X" where no single product is obviously the answer.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: How to get in touch, and which route suits which enquiry — partnerships, white-labelling the APIs, research collaboration, or access to the Veridix platform. Read-only: this reports the routes, it does not send anything.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
